head: f890d14322923f24ce437b25cd1c99d2535903a8
findings: DEFECT-1 (MUST-FIX, reproduced): In default v2-only mode (legacy_compatibility_mode=False, the shipped default), runner.run() CRASHES before processing any translation unit. runner.py sets conn=None when _legacy_compat is False (line 506-521) but then uses conn OUTSIDE the if _legacy_compat guard at: line 579 (with transaction(conn,...) -> upsert_build_context(conn,...) at 583), line 594 (get_file_hashes_by_context(conn,...)), lines 660/668/669 (FTS trigger check + rebuild_fts/drop_fts_triggers(conn)), and line 704 (content_backfill_needed conn.execute). The first crash is AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'execute' at runner.py:583 (upsert_build_context) inside transaction(None) at runner.py:579, then masked by a second AttributeError on conn.rollback() in the transaction context manager (_connection.py:484). Reproduced by invoking runner.run() against tests/fixtures/keep_only with all FW_CONTEXT_* env vars cleared (shipped defaults). The CLI fw-context index (cli/_index.py imports runner.run at line 830) calls runner.run() with shipped defaults and no FW_CONTEXT_LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_MODE override anywhere in src, so normal/default indexing is broken end-to-end.

DEFECT-2 (test-coverage gap, MUST-FIX): The M5 runtime test C32 (LEGACY_UNAVAILABLE_NORMAL_MODE) is a STATIC STRING SEARCH of runner.py (run_m5_runtime_tests.py:113-128) — it only checks that the substring 'if _legacy_compat:' appears in the file text and that 'open_db(db_path)' appears after it. It NEVER executes runner.run(). Consequently C32 reports PASS even though the default v2-only runner path crashes immediately. The contract §18 requires a production-default test lane that exercises 'fresh index -> query -> restart -> query -> reindex' with shipped defaults; no such lane actually runs an index. C30/C31/C33 only assert dataclass defaults / _legacy_compat_on() return values; C34-C36 only exercise gc.py against in-memory SQLite. None of the 7 runtime tests execute the normal indexing path, so the crash went undetected by the gate.

DEFECT-3 (gate weakness): The executable hard gate run_m5_stage_gate.py reports C32 LEGACY_UNAVAILABLE_NORMAL_MODE_PASS = OK while the runner is broken in default mode, so the gate's production-default lane does not actually validate normal operation. The contract §16 requires PRODUCTION_DEFAULT_TEST_LANE == PASS and §18 requires a real fresh-index lane; the current lane is non-executory and gives a false PASS.

OBSERVATION (not blocking): GC invariants are satisfied. gc.py GC_ROOT_STATUSES = {'active','retained'} (line 115); analyze_gc honors pinned_world_ids (line 166) and active_build_world_ids (line 169) and fail-safes unknown statuses to protected (line 184-186); apply_gc checks refcount before deleting a shared SemanticState (lines 304-307: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tu_bindings WHERE state_id=?; delete only if 0); GC is reachability/status-based with no age-only logic. Pin protection and shared-state GC are correctly implemented.

OBSERVATION (not blocking): Config default is correct — settings.py IndexConfig.legacy_compatibility_mode: bool = False (line 518) and _legacy_compat_on() returns False by default (verified). The v2-only intent is correct; the implementation of the runner's v2-only path is what is broken.

OBSERVATION (not blocking): Guarded legacy paths are correctly isolated — open_db (runner.py:509), upsert_project (537), _run_postprocess (1043), assembly store (1006-1010) are all inside if _legacy_compat: guards. The defect is the UNGUARDED legacy conn usage in the per-run preamble (lines 579, 594, 660, 668-669, 704), not the guarded paths.
must_fix: Fix runner.run() so the default v2-only path (conn=None, _legacy_compat=False) does not invoke legacy DB functions outside the if _legacy_compat guard. Either (a) move the per-run preamble blocks that call upsert_build_context (579-587), get_file_hashes_by_context (594), FTS trigger management (660-669), and content_backfill_needed (704-710) inside the if _legacy_compat guard / a v2-equivalent path, or (b) skip them entirely in v2-only mode. Normal/default indexing (`fw-context index` with shipped defaults) must complete a full index without raising AttributeError on a None connection.

Replace the C32 runtime test's static string search with a real execution test that runs runner.run() end-to-end in default v2-only mode (fresh index -> query -> restart -> reindex) as required by contract §18, so a broken default path fails the gate instead of passing silently.
